name: D3D_SetDefaultStates
description: lighting off; solid fill; cull clockwise; linear min/mag; mip point or linear by TextureFilter; fog when the level has fog

name: GL_SetBlendMode
description: blend state cache: 0 off; 1 alpha; 2 add (fog black); 3 filter (fog white); 4 dest-colour/src-colour
evidence: decoded blend factors and fog colour writes

name: R_SetupFog
description: linear table fog; colour also used as clear colour
evidence: decoded fog states; called by level start as2@0x40e1e0

name: R_RenderView
description: scene render: terrain; frustum; marks; skid marks; shadows; opaque; water; trans; effect; particles; sprites; 2D

name: R_DrawMarks
description: CORRECTION of symbols_as2.csv (R_DrawGroundPass): TYPE_MARK pass; depth write off; depth bias 2; per-mark blend; entity RGBA
evidence: walks the TYPE_MARK list filled by as2@0x430740

name: R_DrawSkidMarks
description: CORRECTION of symbols_as2.csv (R_DrawMarks): new skid-mark pass; alpha blend; depth bias 3; write off; Gouraud
evidence: walks the track list as2@0x2113074 filled by as2@0x414850

name: R_DrawSkidMarkStrip
description: CORRECTION of symbols_as2.csv (R_DrawMark): one track as a strip; alpha 1 to 5 s then fade to 0 at 10 s; v = distance / width

name: G_UpdateSkidMarks
description: CORRECTION of symbols_as2.csv (G_UpdatePlayers): per-frame track update; new section every 0.41667 s; 23 sections; terrain height + 2

name: G_FreeSkidMarks
description: CORRECTION of symbols_as2.csv (G_LevelEndHelper): returns every track to the free list
evidence: walks as2@0x20c5da0 into as2@0x20c5d9c; called at level end

name: R_DrawShadows
description: shadow pass: FILTER blend; white vertex colour; depth bias 4; write off

name: R_GenerateShadowMap
description: silhouette into a 512x512 target; 0.6 grey add; no ground-erase quad; linear 2:1 copy into a single-level texture; max 256x256

name: R_RegisterShadowTexture
description: CORRECTION of symbols_as2.csv (R_ShadowMapHelper): registers the generated shadow texture in the texture registry
evidence: copies the name and size into the 2048-slot registry

name: R_DrawBrightness
description: CORRECTION of symbols_as2.csv (R_DrawFadeOverlay): brightness quad dest-colour/src-colour over 800x600
evidence: blend mode 4 and the Brightness value

name: R_ComputeEnvCoords
description: CORRECTION of symbols_as2.csv (R_SetupModelLight): environment coordinates 0.5 + 0.5 * normal in view space
evidence: normals x (world x view); writes the second UV array

name: GL_SetupEnvMap
description: environment stages: GLITTER add; CHROME blend by skin alpha; QUAD modulate with a rotating texture matrix

name: R_SetTextureStage
description: stage 0 texture x diffuse (colour and alpha); stage 1 off

name: R_SetupTerrainStages
description: terrain stages: map texture x diffuse; detail add-signed (else modulate 2x; else modulate)
evidence: decoded texture-stage states and caps test

name: R_SetupWaterStages
description: water stages: base texture; shine blended by its alpha; alpha from the vertex; two scrolled texture matrices (x2; x1.5)

name: R_WaterWaveVertices
description: water grid: waves 16 x weight x 0.5 x (sin(0.75 row + T) + sin(col + T)); normals; unused sun colour

name: R_BuildWaterStrips
description: CORRECTION of symbols_as2.csv (R_LoadTerrain_Copy): water depth weights clamp((level - z)/16) and per-chunk strips of wet cells
evidence: writes the weight array as2@0x2102e74 and strip lists

name: R_BuildTerrainNormals
description: vertex normals from central differences

name: R_BuildTerrainColors
description: static vertex colours: clamp(N.L; 0; 1) x sun + ambient; underwater factor

name: R_BuildTerrainStripsAndTiles
description: terrain strips (flat underwater runs skipped) and tile overlay lists sorted by atlas

name: R_TileCoords
description: tile rectangle in the atlas with a half-texel inset; rotation 3/6/9

name: R_DrawTerrainPatch
description: tile overlays of a chunk: alpha blend; write off; depth bias 1

name: R_DrawWater
description: water pass: alpha blend; t += dt x pi x 0.1; Gouraud

name: R_DrawSprites
description: sprite pass with culling off; billboard axes from the view matrix

name: R_DrawSprite
description: one sprite quad; v = 1 - t

name: R_DrawParticleSystem
description: particle quads with the view-matrix axes; frame div rows quirk kept; FILTER adds texture and colour

name: R_LoadTextureFile
description: loads data\<name> (else .tga; else .jpg) with the Direct3DX file loader; full mip chain or one level

name: GL_Bind
description: SetTexture; index 0 unsets the texture; -notex disables binds

name: G_SyncRenderRecord
description: clamps the colour; FL_ONWATER z from the water surface; FL_ONWATER_FLAT the fixed level; FL_ONWATER_NORMAL aligns to the surface

name: G_AlignToWater
description: axis from the water plane through three samples; yaw kept

name: G_DrawHealthBar
description: adds the hbar_empty and hbar_full sprites when maximum health > 150
evidence: strings hbar_full hbar_empty; same structure as v1.70

name: R_DrawStats
description: debug statistics text in the 2D layer

name: R_Draw2DQuad
description: 2D item: -0.5 pixel shift; optional rotation; optional second texture and combine mode

name: R_Setup2DStages
description: second 2D texture combine: 1 blend by its alpha; 2 add; 3 modulate; else replace
